The plate is roughly 350 px wide, which I take as about 26 cm, so 1 px is about 0.074 cm. The food is a corn cob slice about 95 px across, or roughly 7 cm in diameter. Its height is about 2–3 cm.

Volume is π × 3.5² × 2.5, or about 96 cm³. The cob core takes up part of that, so the edible portion is perhaps 70% of the volume, and corn weighs roughly 0.9 g/cm³. That gives about 60–70 g. I'll estimate 65 g.

Boiled corn on the cob is about 96 kcal per 100 g.
